I also didn't save it to GBrain or memory. Notes there can be read more widely than this DM, so saving it would undercut what Ilse asked for.

I did search GBrain on the Door 2 issue, but the search was keyword-only, so it may have missed things. The only related note was a `#central-random` export, where Tobias Rendle flagged West yard Door 2 double-booking early flatbed check-ins on ticket #8841. Nothing in it confirms a change to #7917. I didn't mention any of this to Ilse, because I didn't check whether they're in that channel.
